senses.gloss: ṭiṭibha, m. (cf. ṭiṭila, tiṭilambha), a high number: Mvy 〔8016〕. Tib. mthaḥ (= Skt. anta) snaṅ (light, brightness; thinking of Skt. bhā ?).
ṭiṭila, nt., a high number: ˚lam Mvy 〔7964〕, cited from LV 〔148.3〕 where tiṭilambha, q.v. Tib. as on LV, confirming -lambha as last part of the word.
